title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
abstract: arXiv:2610.20431v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents' research capabilities through their own experimental experience. Scientific agent swarms can combine evidence and implementations from different research directions to guide their agents' subsequent experiments. However, poor experimental results can leave unclear whether to revise a hypothesis or its implementation, while overall program scores can hide components useful to other agents. To address these challenges, we introduce SwarmRSI, a framework that evolves scientific agent swarms for recursive self-improvement. We devise Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation to refine hypotheses and their implementations using experimental feedback from other agents. We also propose Complementary Swarm Recombination to reuse retained hypotheses and complementary program components across agents, allowing partial results to support new research. translated_title: SwarmRSI：通过演化的科学智能体群体实现递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 科学研究中的递归自我改进（RSI）旨在通过智能体自身的实验经验来提升其研究能力。科学智能体群体可以整合来自不同研究方向的证据和实现方案，以指导智能体的后续实验。然而，糟糕的实验结果会导致不清楚究竟应该修改假设还是修改其实现方案，而整体程序评分可能会掩盖对其他智能体有用的组件。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 SwarmRSI，一个通过演化科学智能体群体来实现递归自我改进的框架。我们设计了反馈引导的群体变异，利用来自其他智能体的实验反馈来完善假设及其实现方案。我们还提出了互补群体重组，以在智能体之间重用保留的假设和互补的程序组件，使部分结果能够支持新的研究。递归群体演化……
tldr: 提出了 SwarmRSI 框架，通过反馈引导的群体变异和互补群体重组两种机制演化科学智能体群体，解决假设与实现修改不明确以及有用组件被隐藏的问题，实现科学研究中的递归自我改进。
en_tdlr: SwarmRSI is a framework that achieves recursive self-improvement in scientific research by evolving agent swarms through feedback-guided swarm mutation and complementary swarm recombination, addressing ambiguous hypothesis-versus-implementation revision and hidden useful components.
